description: The US Nuclear Regulatory Commission publishes Power Reactor Status Reports as part of its reports associated with events. The page, read on 2026-09-26 and last reviewed on 16 September 2026, offers yearly indexes of the reports for every year from 1999 to 2026, a raw data text file of power status for the last 365 days, and an Excel data dictionary. Each daily report, such as that of 25 September 2026, lists every operating unit by NRC region (1 to 4) with its power as a percentage, marked as unevaluated information provided by the facility, and each year also has a raw text file. Files are free to read and download; as US government works they are in the public domain. Caveats: the raw file covers only the last 365 days, so longer histories must be assembled from the yearly indexes, and the page read does not describe the columns beyond the data dictionary. Simulation uses are reactor availability histories for capacity planning and generation adequacy, and measuring how reactors reduce power during heat waves, hurricanes or floods for hazard exposure and resilience studies. Related records: data-nrc-datasets-us-nuclear-facilities lists the reactors, and data-nrc-event-notification-reports explains many shutdowns.
